changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE usuario ADD CONSTRAINT ck_usuario_username_len CHECK (LENGTH(username) BETWEEN 3 AND 100)
ALTER TABLE usuario ADD CONSTRAINT ck_usuario_must_change_pwd CHECK (must_change_password IN ('Y','N'))
ALTER TABLE usuario ADD CONSTRAINT ck_usuario_failed_attempts CHECK (failed_password_attempts >= 0)
ALTER TABLE usuario ADD CONSTRAINT ck_usuario_pwd_algorithm CHECK (password_algorithm IN ('argon2id','bcrypt'))

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Historico de hashes de contrasenia (ARC-111; REQ-069)
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE usuario_password_historico ( password_history_id NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, user_id NUMBER NOT NULL, password_hash VARCHAR2(255 CHAR) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_usuario_password_historico PRIMARY KEY (password_history_id), CONSTRAINT fk_usuario_pwd_hist_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES usuario (user_id) )

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Indice de consulta del historico por usuario y recencia (REQ-069)
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX ix_usuario_pwd_hist_user_fecha ON usuario_password_historico (user_id, created_at DESC)

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Purga que conserva como maximo las 3 ultimas contrasenias por usuario (REQ-069 / AC-PWD-04)
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_usuario_pwd_hist_purga AFTER INSERT ON usuario_password_historico BEGIN DELETE FROM usuario_password_historico WHERE password_history_id IN ( SELECT password_history_id FROM ( SELECT password_history_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at DESC, password_history_id DESC) AS rn FROM usuario_password_historico ) WHERE rn > 3 ); END;
